lines.text: Articles in Ryze write themselves. Here's how to make every one of them yours.

Every article starts from a real keyword. Open one from the plan — the body is fully written, structured with a summary and an FAQ, and scored against checks like internal links, alt texts and meta tags. Until it publishes, everything is editable. Hit Edit.
Title, slug, meta title and description, even the publish date — change anything right here in the editor.
Now the image. Hit Regenerate and describe what you want — say, darker tones and the product outdoors — and the AI reworks the picture following your direction. Or hit Replace and upload your own.

You can also drop your products straight into the article. Type slash, pick the Products block, then search your store. Grab a couple, add them — and real product cards, with prices, sit right inside the text.
Same idea for questions. Add an FAQ block and write your own question and answer. Ryze already generates an FAQ for every article, tuned for voice search — but what you write always wins.

But you don't have to do any of this by hand — you can always ask the assistant. Open the agent from the top bar. Now click into the message box, and tell it exactly what you want: make the intro punchier, and add how much wax tunnelling actually wastes. It reads the article, rewrites it, and the change lands straight in your draft.

Now the global level. Open Settings — the Content tab holds it all. The article language and target market. Article length, from quick reads to deep guides. Tone of voice. And custom writing instructions — type a rule once, and the writer follows it in every single article. You can even add example posts for it to mimic.

Then the pictures. Pick a style — photo realistic, illustration, sketch, watercolor. Or make it truly yours. Choose Your style, and that opens your reference library. Upload a few photos of your own product, as many as you like. Then save — and every image from now on comes out looking like your brand.
That's it. Your products, your voice, your style — in every article the machine writes. And if one needs work, hit Improve This Article, and the agent fixes it with you.
